The supplied records do not substantiate the alert's claim of repeated failures around 13:40 UTC; proxy activity attributed to eli.brooks is present at 13:37, but it is not evidence of domain authentication attempts.
An interactive session for eli.brooks ended on WS-EBROOKS-01 at 14:01:53 UTC; this does not establish whether the earlier failure was related to the alert.
